name: Chana Dal
steps: Rinse and soak the chana dal in plenty of water for 2 hours, then drain. Chop the tomato, ginger and chilli finely.
Bring the drained dal, turmeric and 1000 ml fresh water to a boil. Simmer partly covered for 45–55 minutes, until tender but still holding its shape.
Heat ghee in another pan and sizzle the cumin. Add ginger and chilli for 1 minute, then tomato, salt and chilli powder; cook for 7–8 minutes until pulpy.
Fold the tempering into the dal with the remaining 100 ml water. Simmer for 5 minutes and finish with coriander; the dal should be tender with a light gravy, not a paste.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
